top.title: Biological drug and drug delivery-mediated immunotherapy.
The angiotensin receptor blocker, losartan, reduces inflammation and fibrosis, and prevents relapse of fibrosis after steroid-induced remission, in mice prone to Crohn's disease-like ileitis.
1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D3 and dexamethasone increase interleukin-10 production in CD4+ T cells from patients with Crohn's disease.
